name: Lanthalerhof
beschreibung: The Lanthalerhof is located on the outskirts of Kufstein, nestled in the gentle hilly landscape of the Tiroler Unterland. The house combines traditional architecture with modern comfort and radiates a quiet, down-to-earth atmosphere. Here guests find a place away from the urban bustle, especially suited to those seeking relaxation. The restaurant serves regional cuisine, and the surrounding area invites leisurely walks and easy hikes. Kufstein itself can be reached in just a few minutes.
